newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia cuts repo rates to 18/21 pct from 20/25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia cuts repo rates to 18/21 pct from 20/25 pct.

text.p: Russia's Central Bank said on Monday it was cutting the rate on its two-day repo facility to 18 percent annually from 20 percent for deals concluded on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
A Central Bank official said rates for Thursday and Friday had been cut to 21 percent from 25 percent.
"This has been caused by a reduction in the refinancing rate from today," said the bank's head of securities management, Aleksei Drugov.
The bank lowered on Friday its refinancing rate to 24 percent from 36 percent and also cut some Lombard rates, effective from Monday.
